correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact conditional positive-Gaussian fourth moments: multiplying by d(d+2), the five quartic exponent types are (4)→3, (2,2)→1, (3,1)→4/pi, (2,1,1)→2/pi, (1,1,1,1)→4/pi². In the normalized tracefree u plus edge-v basis, the form equals ||u||²+(1−a)²||v||²+a(1−a)||Bv||²+a²|Σv|²+2Re[(a/√2)〈u,Bv〉], a=2/pi. BB^T=(d−2)I+J splits edge space into constants, standard sector B^T(1-perp), and ker B (dimension d(d−3)/2). The standard 2×2 block is exactly M_d; the constant edge mode gives tau_d. det M=alpha+(d−2)a(1−3a/2)>0 since pi>3, and det(M−alpha I)=(d−2)a²[(2−a)(1−a)−1/2]<0 since 7/11<a. Therefore 0<mu−<alpha<mu+<tau for d≥4, omitting absent alpha at d=3. tau−tr M=d beta+a²d(d−1)/2−1>0. Positive analytic unique continuation gives every eigenvalue below one. tau~a²d²/2, mu−→(pi−3)/(pi−2), giving exact asymptotic 2(pi−2)/[pi²(pi−3)] for the energy concentration ratio, with sqrt for restriction. Degree-one Gram (1−a)I+aJ gives linear contrast. Independently reconstructed full conditional monomial Gamma Gram matrices in d=3..12 and compared all eigenvalues (maximum absolute error <1.2e−14), plus d=100,1000,10000,100000 asymptotic values. Numerical checks only corroborate the all-dimensional analytic argument; initial oversized multiset expansion was avoided in corrected large-d branch-only check.
